critical_code_review_comments: storage.stats().successes stays 0 across the run even though writes are persisting - metric increment on successful flush appears to not be wired. Not blocking, but review mongoStore.flush() to bump successes counter for observability.

Snapshot-based Mongo storage (single doc, cache size ~440KB) is fine for MVP scale but O(N) rewrite of full DB on every write will not scale. Fine now, revisit before >5-10 MB or heavy write concurrency.
